newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - State of Michigan $54 mln.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - State of Michigan $54 mln.

text.p: State Trunk Line Fund Bonds, Series 1996A

Bids will be received by the State of Michigan for the above-referenced Bonds, subject to the provisions of the Preliminary Official Statement, dated October 7, 1996. Time and Date of Sale: To be determined as provided below. On or before 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, October 15, 1996, any person interested in submitting a bid for the Bonds must furnish, in writing, the person's name, address and
telephone number to Wayne R. Niles, Deputy Director, Bureau of Finance and Administration, Michigan Department of
Transportation, 425 West Ottawa Street, Lansing, Michigan, 48909 (facsimile (517) 373-2687, telephone (517) 373-2117.)
The interested bidder may also furnish a facsimile
transmission number. The Michigan Department of

Transportation will notify, or cause to be notified, each person who has so furnished the required information, of the date and time to which bids will be received, not less than 24 hours before the date and time of sale. The notification shall be made by telephone at the number furnished by such person, and also by facsimile transmission if a facsimile number has been received.
Although subject to change, it is currently anticipated that the earliest time and date of sale will be 11:00 a.m., October 22, 1996.
For copies of the Preliminary Official Statement,
containing the information for Bidders and the Bid Form, please contact the State's Financial Advisor, Public

Financial Management, 600 Peachtree Street, NE, Suite 3850, Atlanta, Georgia, 30308, attention: Peter G. Kessenich, Managing Director, telephone (404) 876-1919, facsimile (404) 876-2353, or the Michigan Department of Transportation, attention: Wayne R. Niles at the address set forth above.
